context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [D3D-11]
source: Oh hey. Uh what are you doing here?
target: Ah, hola. Em, ¿qué haces aquí?

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [D3D-12]
source: The person walks towards the counter. I walk behind it just as I usually would.
target: La persona camina hacia el mostrador. Me ubico detrás de este, como es habitual.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, sfx: Smoke_Detector_Beep_2, Next: [AD2]
source: Xey pause as xey look up at the chirping smoke alarm. I watch the gears turn as xey decide to ignore it.
target: Hace una pausa mientras mira hacia el ruidoso detector de humo. Miro cómo reflexiona y decide ignorar el sonido.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA2, Next: [DD3-3]
source: I wanted to see if I can get a snack or something. My phone said this place was open. I wanted to grab something before going back home to Earth.
target: Quería ver si podía conseguir algo para comer. En mi celular decía que este lugar estaba abierto. Quería conseguir algo antes de volver a mi planeta nativo, la Tierra.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [D3D-13]
source: Earth?
target: ¿La Tierra?

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [AD3]
source: Earth isn’t a planet you hear too often when it came to human inhabitants. Despite the supernova, Earth has already been deemed unfavorable for living compared to anywhere else.
target: La Tierra no es un planeta que se escuche mucho cuando hablamos de habitantes humanes. A pesar de la supernova, la tierra ya se consideraba desfavorable para vivir, comparada con cualquier otro lugar.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA3, Next: [AD4]
source: Yeah some people actually still live there.
target: Sí, algunas personas siguen viviendo ahí.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA1, Next: [D3D-14]
source: and by some people I mean me.
target: Y con algunas personas, me refiero a mí.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [DD3-4]
source: I chuckle.
target: Suelto una risita.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [AD5]
source: Well what are you looking for? I can help you pick out something.
target: Bueno, ¿qué tienes en mente? Puedo ayudarte a escoger algo.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA3, Next: [AD6]
source: Well to be honest…I don’t really care. What do you think is good?
target: A decir verdad, realmente no me importa. ¿Qué me recomiendas?

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: Alyana_Short, Next: [AD6b]
source: I’ll take anything.
target: Llevaré lo que sea.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-1]
source: Select an item in the shop
target: Selecciona un artículo de la tienda

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-1]
No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-1]AD6b-Option-2
Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA1, Next: [TDP10-2]
source: Hmm don’t think I’ve tried this before.
target: Mm, creo que no he probado esto antes.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: Alyana_Short, Next: [TDP10-3]
source: How many luncos is it?
target: ¿Cuántas luncas son?

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-4]
source: I’d be crazy to make this company richer by charging you.
target: Sería una locura de mi parte enriquecer a esta empresa con tu dinero.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: Alyana_Short, Next: [TDP10-4a]
source: Just checking.
target: Solo me aseguraba.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA1, Next: [TDP10-5]
source: So what possessed you to clock in when you could be at home or better yet at the Space Port on your way out of here?
target: Así que, ¿qué te poseyó para venir a abrir en lugar de estar en casa o, mejor aún, en el Puerto Espacial para ir hacia otro planeta?

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-6]
source: Just a coward who thinks working at a gas station is more comfortable than confronting my problems head-on.
target: Solo soy una persona sin agallas que cree que trabajar en una gasolinera es más cómodo que afrontar mis problemas directamente.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-7]
source: What about you?
target: ¿Qué hay de ti?

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-8]
source: Xey let out a bitter laugh.
target: Suelta una risa amarga.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: Alyana_Short, Next: [TDP10-9]
source: I stayed behind.
target: Me quedé atrás.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA2, Next: [TDP10-10]
source: You might think it's stupid but I want to stay with the Earth in its final moments.
target: Tal vez creas que es estúpido, pero quiero quedarme con la Tierra en sus últimos momentos.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA1, Next: [TDP10-11]
source: Everyone left it behind and I just don’t want to do the same. I did too much for that floating rock in space. I tried my best.
target: Todo el mundo la abandonó, yo simplemente no quería hacer lo mismo. Hice demasiado por esa roca que flota en el espacio, lo mejor que pude.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-12]
source: You’re just going to get sent to hell with it?
target: ¿Así que solo te vas a ir al infierno con ella?

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA2, Next: [TDP10-13]
source: That does make it sound cooler when you say it like that.
target: Suena mucho más genial si lo dices así.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-14]
source: I don’t really think it's stupid.
target: No creo que sea estúpido.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-15]
source: What's your name? Might as well ask while we’re here.
target: ¿Cómo te llamas? Sirve saberlo mientras estamos aquí.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA3, Next: [TDP10-16]
source: It's Aiyana. Nothing special to it.
target: Soy Aiyana. Nada especial.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-17]
source: Xey look at my name tag. I see as xeir eyes look back down to double check.
target: Aiyana mira la etiqueta con mi nombre. Veo cómo sus ojos vuelven a mirar abajo mientras se asegura de haber leído bien.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: Alyana_Short, Next: [TDP10-18]
source: Thanks for the free stuff Dmi.
target: Gracias por la comida gratis, Dmi.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-19]
source: It's no problem. Just enjoy it. Thanks for being my last customer.
target: Sin problema. Disfrútalo. Gracias por ser mi últime cliente.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA1, Next: [TDP10-20]
source: For what it's worth I think they deserve to know. There isn’t much time left.
target: Si sirve de algo, creo que esa persona merece saber. No queda mucho tiempo.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA3, Next: [TDP10-21]
source: I don’t think anyone should go out with regrets.
target: No creo que alguien deba irse con arrepentimientos.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [TDP10-22]
source: Xey go over to the door.
target: Se dirige hacia la puerta.

context: Sc: Aiyana, msc: Supernova, sfx: ALYANA2, Next: [TDP10-22b]
source: Also take out the batteries in that smoke alarm. You don’t have to be in hell already jeez.
target: Por cierto, quítale las baterias al detector de humo. Todavía no estás en el infierno, vamos.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, sfx: Door_Chime,Door_Close, Next: [D3D-15a]
source: -door opens and closes with a chime-
target: –la puerta suena al abrirse y cerrarse–

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [D3D-15]
source: I grab my broom and give the smoke alarm a solid SMACK.
target: Tomo la escoba y le doy un fuerte golpe al detector. PAM.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [D3D-16]
source: The thing falls to the ground. Aiyana was right about how annoying the noise is when you’re not ignoring it.
target: El artefacto cae al suelo. Aiyana tenía razón, el sonido es muy molesto cuando no lo ignoras.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [D3D-16b]
source: Time passes.
target: El tiempo pasa.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, sfx: Text_1, Next: [PON-1,POP-1]
source: -phone chimes-
target: -suena el celular-

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, sfx: Text_1, Next: [PON-1,POP-1]
No Sc, msc: Supernova, sfx: Text_1, Next: [PON-1,POP-1]D3D-16b-Option-2
No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-2]
source: It's Cassiopeia.
target: Es Casiopea.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-3]
source: I pick up my phone but put it back down.
target: Tomo el celular, pero vuelvo a dejarlo de lado.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-4]
source: Sorry Cassie. Just focus on getting out of here.
target: Perdón, Cas. Enfócate en salir de aquí.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-5]
source: A sinking feeling forms in my stomach as I realize she stopped because its time for her to make her space jump.
target: Se me encoge el corazón al darme cuenta de que se detuvo porque es momento de que haga el salto espacial.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-6]
source: She gave up.
target: Se rindió.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-7]
source: I thought I could handle this.
target: Pensé que podría con esto.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-8]
source: I thought I would be fine.
target: Pensé que estaría bien.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-9]
source: Maybe it would have been better to just tell her. She must have cared if she wanted to speak to me so badly.
target: Tal vez habría sido mejor decirle. Debí importarle si insistió tanto en hablar conmigo.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [PON-10]
source: I pull up a chair next to the window and take a seat.
target: Arrastro una silla a la ventana y me siento.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [PON-11]
source: Cosmic Fuel the place to fill to your heart’s content…
target: Impulso Cósmico, el lugar perfecto para satisfacer el corazón...

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [PON-12]
source: Now it is the place where my heart feels the most empty.
target: Y ahora es donde mi corazón se siente más vacío que nunca.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx
source: I’m an idiot.
target: Qué idiota que soy.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-2]
source: It's time to stop beating around the bush.
target: Es hora de dejar las excusas.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, on phone, msc: Supernova, sfx: Text_4_vibrate, Next: [POP-3]
source: Dmi you’re actually scaring me. Why aren’t you answering?
target: Dmi, me estás asustando. ¿Por qué no respondes?

context: Sc: Dmi, on phone, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-4]
source: I can’t go to the Space Port.
target: No puedo ir al Puerto Espacial.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-5]
source: Silence.
target: Silencio.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, on phone, msc: Supernova, sfx: Text_4_vibrate, Next: [POP-6]
source: Are u at home?
target: ¿Estás en casa?

context: Sc: Dmi, on phone, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-7]
source: No.
target: No.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-8]
source: Silence.
target: Silencio.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, on phone, msc: Supernova, sfx: Text_4_vibrate, Next: [POP-9]
source: Give me a few minutes.
target: Dame unos minutos.

context: Sc: Dmi, on phone, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-10]
source: What
target: ¿Qué?

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-11]
source: Cassiopeia stops replying.
target: Casiopea deja de responderme.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-12]
source: I stare at my phone before typing a few more replies.
target: Miro el celular antes de escribir otra vez.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-13]
source: Nothing.
target: Nada.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-14]
source: Is she mad at me? I know this has gotta take the prize for one of the worst things to ever tell someone.
target: ¿Está enojada conmigo? Definitivamente me ganaría el premio por la peor cosa que puedes decirle a alguien.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-15]
source: Crap.
target: Mierda.

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-16]
source: I should have just come clean earlier. Of course she’s not going to take this well. WHO WOULD?
target: Debería haberle dicho antes. Por supuesto que no se lo tomó bien. ¿QUIÉN LO HARÍA?

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-16b]
source: I place my face in my hands and groan. For some reason the entire universe has been shooting me signs to just come clean and here I am a few hours from Doomsday and I just--
target: Me cubro el rostro con las manos y suelto un quejido. Por alguna razón, todo el universo ha estado enviándome señales para que le dijera, y aquí estoy, horas antes del Fin del Mundo y...

context: No Sc, msc: Supernova, sfx: Door_Chime,Door_Open, Next: [POP-17]
source: -door opens and chimes-
target: -la puerta se abre y suena-

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: Supernova, no sfx, Next: [POP-18]
source: Huh?
target: ¿Eh?

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-19]
source: Every atom in my body freezes as I look at the panting figure standing in the doorway.
target: Cada átomo de mi cuerpo se congela cuando veo a la figura jadeante parada en la puerta.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-20]
source: C-Cassiopeia…?
target: ¿C-Casiopea...?

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS1, Next: [POP-21]
source: You don’t know how hard it was for me to get here in the time I had left.
target: No sabes lo difícil que fue para mí llegar aquí con el tiempo que me quedaba.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-22]
source: She punches me immediately.
target: Me golpea enseguida.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-23]
source: Ow! Cassie!
target: ¡Au! ¡Cas!

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-24]
source: She punches me again.
target: Me golpea otra vez.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS2, Next: [POP-25]
source: Don’t “Ow” me! YOU WOULD PICK NOW OUT OF ALL TIMES TO TELL ME YOU WEREN’T ABLE TO GET CLEARED FOR A SPACE JUMP?
target: ¡No me digas “au”! ¿POR QUÉ ME DICES JUSTO AHORA QUE NO PUDISTE CONSEGUIR PERMISO PARA HACER UN SALTO ESPACIAL?

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-26]
source: She’s fuming understandably so.
target: Está muy enfadada, y con razón.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-27]
source: I’m sorry! I didn’t want you to worry about me!
target: ¡Lo siento! ¡No quería preocuparte!

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-28]
source: Also things just weren’t the best. I…didn’t see how things would get better even if I found a way to go.
target: Y las cosas no están en su mejor momento. No... No vi una forma de mejorar incluso si lograba escapar.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-29]
source: Cassiopeia relaxes.
target: Casiopea se relaja.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: Cassie_Short, Next: [POP-30]
source: Is anyone else here?
target: ¿Hay alguien más aquí?

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-31]
source: It's just me.
target: Solo yo.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS4, Next: [POP-32]
source: Do you guys sell Chai here?
target: ¿Venden chai aquí?

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-33a]
source: Chai has always been Cassiopeia’s choice for an end-of-the-world drink. We’ve had too many late-night “What-if?” conversations for me to not remember.
target: El chai siempre ha sido la bebida que Casiopea elegiría en una situacion del fin del mundo. Hemos tenido demasiadas conversaciones sobre “¿Qué pasaría si...?” como para no recordarlo.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: , Next: [POP-33]
source: I’ll get that for you.
target: Ya te lo traigo.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: Cassie_Short, Next: [POP-34]
source: Thanks Dmi.
target: Gracias, Dmi.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-35]
source: I change the settings of the hot drink machine to Chai and watch as the warm drink pours into the cup.
target: Pongo chai en la configuración de la máquina expendedora y observo cómo la bebida caliente se sirve en una taza.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-36]
source: I place the cup down on the counter in front of me and push it toward her.
target: Pongo la taza en el mostrador delante de mí y la deslizo hacia Cas.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: Cassie_Short, Next: [POP-37]
source: Dmi come.
target: Dmi, ven.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-38]
source: She moves over to the window with her Chai in hand. I grab my chair and an extra from behind the counter and drag them over to her.
target: Va hacia la ventana con el chai en mano. Tomo mi silla y una extra de detrás del mostrador y las arrastro hacia ella.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-38b]
source: She takes a long sip of her drink before sitting down.
target: Cas toma un largo sorbo de su bebida antes de sentarse.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: Smoke_Detector_Beep_2, Next: [POP-39]
source: -smoke alarm chirps-
target: -suena el detector de humo-

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-40]
source: Cassiopeia searches for the sound. I grab a nearby broom.
target: Casiopea busca el sonido. Agarro la escoba más cercana.

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-41]
source: Give me a second.
target: Dame un momento.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-42]
source: I land a solid SMACK at the smoke alarm and watch as it falls to pieces.
target: Le doy un fuerte golpe al detector de humo, PAM, y miro cómo cae en pedazos.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-43]
source: Cassiopeia doesn’t say a word as I bring myself next to her.
target: Casiopea no dice nada mientras me acerco a ella.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: Cassie_Short, Next: [POP-44]
source: As I was saying…
target: Como decía...

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS4, Next: [POP-45]
source: Did you ever think about what happens after the supernova if you never told me?
target: ¿Alguna vez pensaste en qué pasaría después de la supernova si nunca me decías?

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-46]
source: You’d carry on without me. Probably. Cassie you’re not even going to make it back in time!
target: Seguirías sin mi, probablemente. ¡Cas, ni siquiera vas a lograr volver a tiempo!

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-47]
source: Cassiopeia doesn’t answer. She takes another sip of her cheap gas station Chai.
target: Casiopea no responde. Toma otro sorbo de su chai barato de gasolinera.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS3, Next: [POP-48]
source: Nice try. Dmi you’re one of the most important people to me.
target: Buen intento. Dmi, eres una de las personas más importantes en mi vida.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS1, Next: [POP-49]
source: I’m here because I want to be here with you!
target: ¡Estoy aquí porque quiero estar contigo!

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-50]
source: Cass--
target: Cas...

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS2, Next: [POP-51]
source: You have been giving me the slip for days and I knew something was up!
target: Has estado huyendo de mí por días, ¡sabía que te pasaba algo!

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-52]
source: Tears well up in my eyes. I can’t help it.
target: Las lágrimas se acumulan en mis ojos. No puedo evitarlo.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: Cassie_Short, Next: [POP-53]
source: Dmi? Come on…
target: ¿Dmi? Vamos...

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-54]
source: She takes me into her arms before she wipes at my tears. She holds my face in her hands. I can’t pinpoint the emotion I see in her face.
target: Me toma entre sus brazos antes de limpiar mis lágrimas. Acurruca mi rostro entre sus manos. No puedo entender exactamente la expresión de su rostro.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-55]
source: Was it pity?
target: ¿Era lástima?

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS1, Next: [POP-56]
source: I want to be here with you. Don’t cry.
target: Quiero estar aquí, contigo. No llores.

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-57]
source: …love? Was that it?
target: ... ¿Amor? ¿Eso era?

context: Sc: Dmi, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-58]
source: I wish we had more time. I wish we could have done more things together or had a chance to just live in another galaxy. Or at least you should be able to leave--
target: Desearía que tuviéramos más tiempo. Desearía que pudiéramos hacer más cosas o tener la posibilidad de vivir en otra galaxia. O que al menos tú hubieras podido irte...

context: No Sc, msc: BracingForImpact, no sfx, Next: [POP-59]
source: Cassiopeia wipes at my tears some more. I see her own tears threaten to fall.
target: Casiopea limpia más de mis lágrimas. Veo cómo algunas lágrimas intentan caer de sus ojos.

context: Sc: Cassiopeia, msc: BracingForImpact, sfx: CASS3, Next: [POP-60]
source: I don’t want to leave without you.
target: No quiero irme sin ti.
